WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE dt < CURDATE() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dr.dt, '%m/%d') AS date , COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.mbr_role = 'ROLE_MECHANIC' THEN s.session_id END), 0) AS 정비사 , COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.mbr_role = 'ROLE_MANAGER' THEN s.session_id END), 0) AS 관리자
FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN svc_stat_use s ON DATE(s.reg_dt) = dr.dt AND s.mbr_id != ''
AND s.ownr_nm IN
#{ownr}
AND s.ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
OR s.ownr_nm = ''
GROUP BY dr.dt ORDER BY dr.dt
